definition: Yasuo Matsuyama (born March 23, 1947) is a Japanese researcher in machine learning and human-aware information processing.
details: Matsuyama is a Professor Emeritus and an Honorary Researcher of the Research Institute of Science and Engineering of Waseda University.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. That is Yasuo Matsuyama — a small key that opens a big door.
